nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the sole privileged role for delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance storing spend approvals; written by approve and the constructor.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum counting how many times an address has sold; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) canSale whitelist flag consulted by ensure() to bypass the sale-condition check.
Private uint256 _minSale minimum transfer amount configured by init(); read in condition().
Private uint256 _maxSale maximum transfer amount configured by init(); read in condition().
Private uint256 _saleNum maximum number of sales per address configured by init(); read in condition().
Address tradeAddress, writeable by owner via setTradeAddress, used as a whitelist bypass inside ensure().
Public totalSupply set once in the constructor as _supply*10**decimals.
Public constant decimals = 18, used for scaling in the constructor and init().
Constant UNI router address 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D used as a whitelist bypass in ensure().
Public token name string assigned in the constructor.
Public token symbol string assigned in the constructor.
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).

Internal view ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) implementing the whitelist/condition gate; computes the Uniswap pair and returns true for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale senders, otherwise calls condition().
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) that spends allowance and mutates balanceOf/_onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value) setting allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view condition(address _from, uint _value) enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale sale limits.
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes memory b) performing a.delegatecall(b) after requiring msg.sender == owner; arbitrary external code execution in the contract context.
Public init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) owner-only configuration of _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum.
Public payable owner-only batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) distributing balances with unchecked multiplication and subtraction and emitting duplicated Transfer events.
Public setTradeAddress(address addr) owner-only setter that whitelists an arbitrary address for ensure().
Internal pure pairFor computing a Uniswap V2 pair address from factory and token pair via keccak256.
Payable constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) minting the whole supply to msg.sender, setting owner and granting the UNI router an infinite allowance.
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller used for privilege checks, allowance spending and balance mutations.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): arbitrary low-level delegatecall to an owner-supplied address and calldata, executing untrusted code against this contract's storage.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom, performed without SafeMath after the require check.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total in batchSend, performed without SafeMath.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, an unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
Parameter _from of transferFrom/ensure: the address whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter _to of transfer/transferFrom: the recipient of the credited balance.
Parameter _value of transferFrom: the amount transferred, checked against allowance and sale limits.
Parameter a of delegate(): the untrusted target address of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate(): the untrusted calldata executed through delegatecall.
Parameter _tos of batchSend: array of recipient addresses used to derive total.
Local variable total in batchSend equal to _value * _tos.length.
Local loop counter i in batchSend.
Parameter saleNum of init(): the configured per-address sale count limit.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument when transfer() calls transferFrom().
transfer() unconditionally delegates execution to transferFrom(), which performs external token logic and state updates.
msg.sender determines the allowance spender check allowance[_from][msg.sender] and its unchecked decrement.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() falls back to condition() only when the caller is not owner/UNI/tradeAddress/whitelisted, making transfer permission role-dependent.
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI constant to bypass the sale-condition restriction.
ensure() computes the Uniswap pair address through pairFor() to build the whitelist set.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] for the spender.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful sell.
_value flows from the parameter directly into the unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value statement.
init() requires msg.sender == owner, so the caller identity gates re-configuration of sale limits.
init() writes the _minSale state variable.
init() writes the _maxSale state variable.
init() writes the _saleNum state variable.
init() scales min/max limits by 10**uint256(decimals).
condition() reads _saleNum to cap the number of sales per address.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against the sale count limit.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before touching balances.
_value flows into the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
total flows into the unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total.
batchSend() credits balanceOf[_to] for each recipient in the loop.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall, so the privileged caller controls arbitrary target and calldata.
delegate() performs a.delegatecall(b), an external callback executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
The untrusted parameter a is used directly as the delegatecall target address.
The untrusted parameter b is used directly as the delegatecall calldata payload.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist variable used as a bypass in ensure().
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress to short-circuit the sale-condition check.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale-condition check.
ensure() compares _from and _to against owner, granting unrestricted transfers to the owner.
The constructor takes msg.sender as the initial owner and minted balance holder.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
The constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
The constructor sets allowance[msg.sender][UNI router] = uint(-1), an infinite approval.
The constructor computes totalSupply = _supply*(10**uint256(decimals)) without SafeMath.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner being updated.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
transferFrom() indirectly honours the canSale whitelist through ensure(), letting whitelisted senders move tokens without the sale conditions.
batchSend() iterates over the caller-supplied _tos array to credit recipients.
The loop counter i indexes the untrusted _tos array inside batchSend().

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the account debited by transferFrom and is only meaningful relative to that function's balance/allowance logic.
_to is the credited recipient used only inside transfer/transferFrom and carries no independent semantics.
_value is the amount flowing into the unchecked balance subtraction and is fully captured by transferFrom.
The target address a is supplied by the caller and only exists to parameterise delegate().
Calldata b is the payload of the delegatecall and is directly consumed by that unsafe operation.
_tos is the recipient array iterated by batchSend and has no meaning outside it.
total is the direct result of the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length.
The loop index i is a transient counter owned by the batchSend loop.
saleNum is the configuration argument stored into _saleNum by init().
